items.quote: My clients message me and BossZap organizes everything on the calendar. The PDF quotes give my salon a super professional image.

items.name: Roberto Silva
items.quote: The financial tracking changed my business. Now I know exactly how much I spent on materials and how much I earned. All through WhatsApp.

items.question: Do I need to install any app?
items.answer: No! BossZap works 100% through the WhatsApp you already have on your phone. There's also a web dashboard that opens right in your browser. Zero installation.

items.question: Does it work with voice or just text?
items.answer: Both! You can send text or voice messages. Our AI transcribes audio automatically and understands what you need.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. No contracts, no commitments, no penalties. Cancel whenever you want from your dashboard. During the 7-day trial, we charge nothing.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption, secure servers, and comply with data protection regulations. Your data belongs to you.

items.question: How many people can use my account?
items.answer: Each account is linked to one WhatsApp number. It's ideal for solo entrepreneurs and small teams.

items.question: Do the PDF quotes have my branding?
items.answer: Yes! The PDF includes your business name, address, phone, email, and logo. Your clients see your brand, not BossZap's.
